title: Prove frame span m+1 cannot save a bit-model call in any dimension (no new κ)
body:
## Result

**Scoped written proof with an exact finite check. No new κ, no supplier change, selected frontier unchanged.**

Model: the abelian scalar-idempotent register model (eumemic's PR #288 §1.2, as stated by Ali Romman's PR #468), with `m x m` rational rank-one frames, `W` registers and invertible targets. In every address dimension `m`, a paid-frame span of dimension at most `m + 1` forces at least `mW` calls for invertible lower-triangular targets. PR #468 proves this only at `m = 3` (its span-four lemma). The direct word attains `mW`.

After Cauchy–Binet normalization, the span is `diag + t·uv^T`. Let `K = supp u ∩ supp v`:

| Case | Argument | Targets |
| --- | --- | --- |
| span `<= m` | PR #468 low-span lemma (cited) | any invertible |
| `|K| >= 3` | **new**: the minor on rows `{i,k}`, columns `{i,l}` is `D_ii t u_k v_l`, so every rank-one element lies on one of `m + 1` lines; line projection gives `mW` | any invertible |
| `|K| <= 1` | **new reduction**: the arc graph is acyclic, so the span is triangular after a permutation; diagonal projection gives `mW` | any invertible |
| `|K| = 2` | PR #468 block flag argument, cited, not rechecked | lower triangular |

PR #468's step needs full support of `u, v`, and its component bound needs blocks of size at most two. Neither holds in dimension four or more once frames have zero coordinates. This PR replaces both steps with the `|K|` split.

Package: `research/span-lemma-every-dimension` (README, PROOF.md, verify.py).

## Evidence and reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/span-lemma-every-dimension/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/span-lemma-every-dimension/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/span-lemma-every-dimension
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/span-lemma-every-dimension --check-source-history
```

Local results (CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64): both verifier runs print `PASS_SPAN_LEMMA_EVERY_DIMENSION` in 0.37 s. The package check prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. The commit check prints `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

The verifier checks:
- The support classification for every pair of nonempty supports with `m <= 7`. For `|K| >= 3`, each index has the minor witnesses. The only nontrivial strongly connected component is `K` when `|K| >= 2`. The graph is acyclic when `|K| <= 1`.
- The minor identity, as a polynomial identity.
- An exact integer rank-one grid at `m = 3, 4, 5`: 434,845 matrices and zero off-line rank-one elements.
- Two controls: the rank detector, and an explicit off-line rank-one element at `|K| = 2` (`u = v = (1,1,0)`, `D = diag(2,2,0)`, `t = -1`), which shows that Lemma C fails there.

## Limitations

- The `|K| = 2` case relies on PR #468's block flag argument and its lower-triangular target hypothesis, which is cited and not rechecked.
- Not covered: span `m + 2` or more, extra clean or dirty registers, free address maps between paid calls, nonabelian models, and native conversion.
- The finite grid is a control. The theorem rests on the written proof. Independent human review and proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Does `|K| = 2` still force `mW` for non-triangular invertible targets? Start at `m = 2` with full-support `u, v`.
2. Does span `m + 2` force `mW` for `m >= 4`? Classify the joint support graph of the two extra frames.
3. Do clean or dirty extra registers change the span-`(m+1)` bound in dimension `m`?

## Related open work

No open PR studies the general-dimension span lemma. Open register-model PRs (for example #3893, an S3 three-register rank bound, and #5963, C3 inverse targets) use different alphabets or targets. This PR computes no number they report.

This account's open PRs opened since the claim (#5989 two-guard reciprocal, #5990 fused two-root readout, #5992 pooled R437 carrier moment) study different objects. None computes a quantity this PR computes.

## Credit

Produced by Nick Petalas. Model: eumemic, PR #288. Low-span lemma, span-four lemma at `m = 3`, projection tools and block flag argument: Ali Romman, PR #468. Common triangular-flag obstruction: huxint, PR #203. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19226223
